variants.prompt: The French beauty strides confidently across a sleek, black leather yacht deck at dusk. A barely-there, metallic bikini leaves little to the imagination, emphasizing her taut, sun-kissed physique. Emerald eyes sparkle under the waning sunlight as she tosses honey-blonde locks over one shoulder. The metallic fabric catches the fading light, accentuating her curves and cleavage. A delicate gold chain adorns her neck, and strappy high-heeled sandals add a touch of sophistication. The camera captures her in a tight medium shot from the side, emphasizing her toned, athletic build.
